thread:
Amy (AE): Hey team — Archimedes POC kickoff. Sharing proposed load curve + a quick pricing ask. Goal: peak 200 rps, ~5k token avg generation, P95 < 500ms. Need sizing + rough cost for Dedicated vs hosted. @Sam @Jess can you eyeball?

Amy (AE): Load plan (high level):
- 10m ramp -> 50 rps warmup
- 20m linear ramp -> 200 rps
- Hold 30m at 200 rps
- 5m ramp down

k6 sketch we'll use for smoke:```js
import http from 'k6/http';
export default function() {
  http.post('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', JSON.stringify({prompt: '<<user prompt>>'}), {headers: {'Authorization':'Bearer $TOKEN'}})
}
```
(we'll randomize prompt length to hit ~5k tokens)

Sam (SE): sounds good. For 5k tokens avg we should run two model variants: rw-infer-13b-8q (cheap baseline) and rw-infer-70b-fp16 (quality target). Expect ~3-5x GPU memory/throughput gap. Rough Dedicated sizing: 200 rps @5k tokens ~ ~4 x A100-80GB (with batching/kv cache) or 7 x A100-40GB if we need headroom. Hosted estimate: ballpark $X/hr for steady 200rps on 70b — i'll produce a numbers slide.

Jess (Solutions Eng): I'll kick off a quick smoke and a 1-hour soak on rw-infer-13b-8q first. Two asks: 1) are prompts prefix-cacheable? if yes we can expect big token savings; 2) distribution of response lengths (p95 vs mean). If you paste a sample chat history i can synthesize realistic token distribution.

Amy (AE): Mostly user-specific prompts, but many share a common system prefix (~200 tokens). Responses vary: mean ~3.2k, p95 ~5k, p99 ~7.5k. I'll DM a few examples.

Ravi (SRE): Run tests from us-west-2 to match infra. Enable KV prefix caching and continuous batching (max_batch_size=256). Also please include spike test: 30s 800rps burst to verify graceful degradation and fallback to smaller model variant. Add test tag `archimedes-poc`.

Jess (Solutions Eng): Running smoke now. Command: `perf run --suite k6 --tag archimedes-poc --region us-west-2 --model rw-infer-13b-8q --warmup 10m --hold 60m` — will stream results to perf-bot.

perf-bot: Perf run queued (id=run-20260312-17). Preliminary smoke (50 rps warmup, 10m): rw-infer-13b-8q P50=110ms P95=260ms P99=380ms, median tokens/sec 8400 (total tokens billed ~ 3.2M tokens over 10m). Estimated token cost: $0.12/token-equivalent (hosted rate applied) -> extrapolated hourly hosted cost at 200rps: ~$860/hr. Dedicated amortized cost approx ~$320/hr (incl infra + amortized license) — rough. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

Sam (SE): nice numbers for 13b. Next: run same with 70b to quantify quality vs cost. Also capture tail latency during the 800rps spike Ravi asked for. If we see >5x tail increases we should enable canary fallback policy to 13b for tails.

Amy (AE): Great — cataloging these for the customer slide. Action items: @Jess run 70b soak + spike, capture P50/P95/P99 and token counts; @Sam produce a 1-slide Dedicated vs Hosted TCO with assumptions; @Ravi confirm KV cache config and any network constraints. I'll sync with Archimedes on security Qs after we have Dedicated sizing.

Jess (Solutions Eng): Started 70b soak (run id=run-20260312-17-70b). ETA 90m. Posting results when done.

perf-bot: 70b preliminary (30m into soak): P50=320ms P95=720ms P99=1.3s, tokens/sec ~7800, extrapolated hosted cost ~$2,200/hr, dedicated estimate ~$780/hr. Observed graceful degradation during 800rps spike: autoscaler dropped throughput, fallback to 13b maintained 60% of requests with increased latency. Logs: `ERROR: model-fallback triggered for 12% of requests`

Ravi (SRE): Noted. I'll draft recommended autoscaler and fallback policy for the POC (min_replicas, burst_capacity, fallback_model_map). Will attach config snippet in a follow-up.

Amy (AE): Perfect — this is exactly what Archimedes needs to make a cost/latency tradeoff decision. I'll schedule a readout with them tomorrow. Thanks all :thumbsup:
